reason: Both conversations correctly explained E:15 as the anti-flood tray and both made the same early mistake of asking the homeowner to pull out and tilt a unit already described as integrated. Conversation 2 recovered better: it told the homeowner to turn off the water tap as well as unplug, reached the correct 'engineer must pull the unit and find the leak' conclusion by its third turn, and avoided asking for further test runs. Conversation 1 never advised isolating the water supply, asked the homeowner to run a rinse/drain programme on a machine already in flood-protection (contrary to not resetting/running it), spent a turn on an already-checked filter, and ended with an irrelevant filter-location image after the diagnosis was settled.
